title: Appeals for Exemption from Studying Mother Tongue Language
what_it_is: Appeals for Exemption from Studying Mother Tongue Language

sections.label: MTL exemption for students
sections.summary: MTL exemption is granted only in exceptional circumstances, such as mid-stream entry without official MTL or certified SEN, with about 2.3% of Primary 6 students exempted annually due to SEN.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Students may only be granted MTL exemption under exceptional circumstances, such as, if they join our schools mid-stream without having learnt an official MTL or when they have certified Special Educational Needs (SEN) that severely affect their ability to cope with overall learning.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Over the past three years, the proportion of Primary 6 students exempted from offering MTL due to SEN has remained fairly stable, at around 2.3% annually.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: MTL exemption applications and appeals are evaluated by a Ministry of Education (MOE) panel.

sections.label: Two MTL exemption segments
sections.summary: The speaker states that two target segments of students are considered for MTL exemption.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Earlier on, in my answer, I did specify that there are two target segments of students that we will consider granting the MTL exemption.

sections.label: No arithmetic formula for marks
sections.summary: The speaker says there is no arithmetic formula for the marks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The answer to the Member's first question about the marks, there is no arithmetic formula per se.

sections.label: Foundation MTL exam components
sections.summary: A Primary 5 Foundation MTL student need not write MTL in exams, as marks come from Oral, Listening Comprehension and multiple-choice Comprehension, and MTL lessons are being brought to heartlands with SkillsFuture Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: For example, if a Primary 5 student takes Foundation MTL, he or she, at this point in time, does not need to write a single character or word in MTL during exams.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Because 55% of the marks are based on Oral Exam, 30% are based on Listening Comprehension and the other 15% are based on Comprehension with multiple choice answers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: As for the third question, yes, this is why we are working with SkillsFuture Singapore to bring MTL lessons into the heartlands to allow adult learners to continue to hone their proficiency in MTL.
